## Purpose

A `*Record` struct captures the outcome of running ONE subprocess against ONE subproject discovered from grain's repo model — `InstallRecord` (maint_deps.rs) and `ValidateRecord` (maint_validate.rs) are near-identical siblings, both driven by a `<kind>_command(kind: &str) -> Option<(&'static str, Vec<&'static str>)>` lookup table mapping grain's project `kind` (npm/cargo/dotnet/go/pub/maven) to the canonical shell command for that action.

## Convention

Folder: apps/rt/src/commands/maint/** · Extension: .rs · Files of this role in this subproject: 2

Records are `#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]` with exactly four fields: `subproject`, `command` (the rendered `"bin arg1 arg2"` string), `ok`, `duration_ms`. Subprojects are ALWAYS enumerated via `mustard_core::read_projects(&model)` reading `.claude/grain.model.json` — never parsed directly or hand-listed. An unmapped project `kind` is silently skipped (`continue`), never an error. `--dry-run` short-circuits before spawning, still pushing a record with `ok: true, duration_ms: 0`.

## How to apply

Add a new maint action by copying this exact shape: a `<verb>_command(kind: &str) -> Option<(&'static str, Vec<&'static str>)>` match table, a `<Verb>Record` struct with the same four fields, and a `<verb>_all(dry_run: bool) -> <Verb>Report` driver iterating `mustard_core::read_projects`. Reuse `mustard_core::platform::process::rtk_command` for the actual spawn, and emit the operation via `shared::events::economy::emit_operation`.

## Examples

Ref: apps/rt/src/commands/maint/maint_deps.rs
Ref: apps/rt/src/commands/maint/maint_validate.rs

```rust
#[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
pub(crate) struct InstallRecord {
    pub subproject: String,
    pub command: String,
    pub ok: bool,
    pub duration_ms: u64,
}

#[must_use]
pub(crate) fn install_command(kind: &str) -> Option<(&'static str, Vec<&'static str>)> {
    match kind.to_ascii_lowercase().as_str() {
        "npm" | "node" | "typescript" | "javascript" | "react" | "nextjs" | "next" => {
            Some(("pnpm", vec!["install"]))
        }
        "cargo" | "rust" => Some(("cargo", vec!["fetch"])),
        _ => None,
    }
}
```
